population: Canonical M9P N3 XAUUSD LONG first-turn population, 1495 trades, 2023-01-03 through 2026-06-19
evidence_warning: All historical periods used here are research-exposed. These overlays are hypotheses for fresh prospective accounting shadow only, not historically validated gates.

loss_reduction_hypothesis.definition: Keep every N3 signal. Assign virtual size 0.50x when entry is in the already-described N6 H4 RCI9 percentile risk zone; assign 1.00x otherwise. This is sizing/accounting only, not an entry rejection or stop.
loss_reduction_hypothesis.interpretation: Historically, halving exposure in the N6 risk state reduces loss magnitude and DD without reducing signal frequency, but must be prospectively tested because N6 was discovered on exposed history.

profit_extension_hypothesis.definition: At the unchanged M7C exit decision, inspect the latest fully closed H1 MACD(6,13) line. If the H1 MACD line is rising versus its prior closed H1 bar, close 50% at the original M7C exit and keep 50% as a runner until the first subsequent fully closed M15 RCI9 turn-down, exiting at the next exact M1/M15 decision open. Otherwise close 100% at the original M7C exit.
profit_extension_hypothesis.interpretation: The runner increases net profit and PF but lowers closed-trade win rate and slightly increases DD when used alone. It is therefore not a standalone promotion candidate.

combined_hypothesis.definition: Q1 virtual half-risk accounting at entry plus Q2 selective 50% runner at exit. Signal timestamps are unchanged.

historical_exploratory_metrics.quarter_note: 12 of 14 observed quarters remain above PF 1; 2024Q4 and 2025Q3 remain weak, so the overlay does not eliminate regime risk.

combined_hypothesis.interpretation: Historically the combined accounting changes the payoff profile from mildly loss-larger-than-win to roughly balanced average win/loss, while reducing DD and increasing PF. This is the leading fresh prospective risk/reward hypothesis, not a live rule.

research_decision: Do not tighten a fixed stop solely to improve the historical average loss.
Do not reject N6 entries historically; test N6 as virtual size reduction in a fresh prospective accounting arm.
Do not replace the M7C exit historically; test the selective runner in a separate fresh prospective accounting arm.
Use a four-arm fresh GOLD prospective shadow: N3 base, Q1 risk-only, Q2 runner-only, Q3 combined.
Keep M8C and M7C unchanged and do not reuse their prospective start.
